# proxmox_acl (Resource)

Manages Proxmox VE ACL permissions for a given path through `/access/acl`. This resource binds roles to users and/or groups on the given path. At least one of `users` or `groups` must be set, and `roles` must have at least one entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_acl" "vm_101" {
  path      = "/vms/101"
  propagate = true
  roles     = [proxmox_role.terraform.role_id]
  users     = [proxmox_user.deploy.user_id]
  groups    = [proxmox_group.admins.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Proxmox object path (e.g. `/`, `/vms/101`, `/storage/local-lvm`, `/pool/my-pool`). Changes require replacement.
- `roles` (List of String) List of role IDs to assign.

### Optional

- `groups` (List of String) List of group IDs to assign the roles to. At least one of `users` or `groups` must be set.
- `propagate` (Boolean) Allow permissions to propagate (inherit) to child objects. Defaults to true.
- `users` (List of String) List of user IDs (e.g. `admin@pam`) to assign the roles to. At least one of `users` or `groups` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier derived from the ACL path.
